codeReview.summary: Manifest pinning (VAL-BENCH-003) and environment metadata capture (VAL-BENCH-005) are implemented with solid focused tests, but VAL-BENCH-004 is not fully enforced in the harness because correctness-gate failure does not currently fail smoke/run commands. Confidence: high.

issues.description: The harness computes correctness gate status (`gate_status = gate_result["gate"].upper()` at line 601) but smoke/run exit logic only fails on `cell_totals.errors` (lines 721 and 750). A failing correctness gate can therefore still return success, so benchmark performance flow is not hard-blocked by correctness failures as required by the feature's expected behavior for VAL-BENCH-004.
Failure-detail printing checks `hash_divergence`, but scenario detail entries are written under `parity_divergence` (line 154), so parity hash divergence details are suppressed in CLI failure output.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The benchmark-worker skill does not explicitly state that VAL-BENCH-004 requires hard enforcement (non-zero/fail-state propagation) when correctness gating fails, which likely contributed to gate status being recorded but not enforced in harness exit behavior.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/benchmark-worker/SKILL.md Work Procedure references gate tests and artifact generation but not fail-state propagation; commit 285b87b harness code computes `gate_status` without using it in smoke/run exit conditions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared benchmarking knowledge does not capture the parity-pair rule (ag/rust-ag hard gate, cross-tool divergence advisory) that was discovered during implementation.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff.skillFeedback.suggestedChanges calls this out; .factory/library/benchmarking.md currently lists controls/outputs but omits parity-pair correctness semantics.

summary: I reviewed feature metadata, handoff, transcript skeleton, skill guidance, and commit 285b87b diffs. The feature has good coverage for manifest pinning and environment metadata, but I marked it failed due to missing hard propagation of correctness-gate failure in harness smoke/run paths; one additional non-blocking CLI reporting key mismatch was found.
